## Background enrichment worker
Only 75 - TOOL - start_enrichment queues this workflow. One bounded Apify actor run (one-by-one company batches, 3 profiles each, hard maxTotalChargeUsd ceiling), polled every 20 seconds for up to 15 minutes, then one Claude call per company to pick the best contact.

Deterministic guards after the model: any email, profile URL or name the picker returns that is NOT present in the scraped data is dropped and the row is downgraded and flagged — invented contact details cannot reach the store. Results write back through the chat app's local API; job status is updated at every stage so get_enrichment can report honestly.

NOTE (31 Aug 2026): the actor requires maxItems or takePages. Without one it exits SUCCEEDED with zero items and status 'no limits' - a silent no-op that reads as 'no profiles returned' for every company. Do not remove maxItems.
